long_biography.plain_text:
Containerisation became Lucien Arkas's decisive bet as he reshaped his family's İzmir agency. Two years after taking control, he abandoned tourism and import trading to concentrate on maritime commerce. An Istanbul office broadened the agency network, and Arkas handled the first container shipment from Turkey in 1978.

Arkas carried container transport beyond the dock. He built road and rail links between inland manufacturers and ports, combining shipping agency work with line operations, terminals and logistics. His cultural work has made the Arkas Collection public through several İzmir art centres; the collection has been assembled over more than three decades.
